# Stageshow kit (vendored)

The parts of the Stageshow kit that the home page's animated How it works cards use (`src/components/how-demos.tsx`, D-216): the `Stage` and its script, the `Phone` frame, `Roll` and `Check`. Copied unchanged from Stageshow 0.1.0 (`~/.claude/skills/stageshow/kit`), MIT licensed (`LICENSE`).

Do not edit these files. To update, copy the same files again from the skill's `kit/`. To use another part, copy it with every file it imports. ESLint skips this folder (`eslint.config.mjs`).
